scripts.build:dashboard: pnpm with-env turbo run build -F dashboard
scripts.start:dashboard: pnpm with-env turbo run start -F dashboard
scripts.build:api: pnpm with-env turbo run build -F api
scripts.start:api: pnpm with-env turbo run start -F api

scripts.dev:api: pnpm with-env turbo run dev -F api --
